note: Sequoia NF campground on the Wild and Scenic North Fork Kern River, 4 miles north of Kernville on paved Mountain 99; a mix of RV, standard and tent-only sites plus two yurts. The north-end sites look over the river across open sand; sites farther from the river are open with little shade. No camping within 25 ft of the water's edge; swimming is discouraged because of strong currents. Run by the ExplorUS concession. --Claude
